R=[[5,0,5,0],[5,5,0,0],[0,0,5,5],[0,5,5,0]]
O=[[0,0,0,0],[0,0,4,4],[0,4,0,0],[4,0,0,4]]
def coords(g,c): return {(i,j) for i,row in enumerate(g) for j,x in enumerate(row) if x==c}
A=coords(L,6); B=coords(R,5); C=coords(O,4)
def transforms(g):
  out=[]
  x=g
  for k in range(4):
    out.append((f'rot{k*90}',x))
    out.append((f'fliprot{k*90}',[list(reversed(row)) for row in x]))
    x=[list(row) for row in zip(*x[::-1])]
  return out
for n,g in transforms(L):
